rows.en:
Well, every now and then, it's nice to take it
easy and spend some ordinary time like this.
Yeah? I'm glad.
Now, where to next time? You'd better think it over!
Hahaha, that's a tough one...
(Sheryl's just a girl my age after all, huh.)
(Today I'll try taking her to "Silver Moon"...)
rows.notes: Silver Moon is provisional in the glossary.

rows.en:
\p-chan,
you took your time.
Whoa, you got here before me...
Today it's a place we Mihoshi students go a lot.
Oh, really? Then let's just go and see.

Well, it's just an ordinary cafe, but it's a
must for any Mihoshi student, so I thought
I'd show you around, just in case...
Thank goodness~
Sheryl-san...?
Oh, that's right...
Really? I'm glad.
Now, where to next time? Think it over, okay?
Hmm, what should I do...
(Sheryl-san's just a girl my age after all.)

(Okay, I promised to go to "Silver Moon"
with Sheryl again today...)
rows.notes: Silver Moon is provisional in the glossary.

rows.en: \p, you're late!
You're early again today, Sheryl.

Well, of course!
Come on, let's go!

Phew, I really like it here.
It's open, there are just enough people around...
It's relaxing.
This is student life, all right.
Well, it actually IS student life...
N-no, nothing... at all...
(Sheryl seems to be really enjoying school life.)

(Okay, I promised to go to "Silver Moon"
with Sheryl-san again today...)
rows.notes: Silver Moon is provisional in the glossary.

rows.en: \p-chan, you're late!
You're early again today, Sheryl-san.
Well, it actually IS student life...
(Sheryl-san seems to be really enjoying school life.)

(I've pretty much shown her everything around
the school... That place is all that's left...)

Hi~, \p.
So... what about today?
Are you going to show me a proper good time?

Today we're going to the best place in school
to unwind...

What!? There's still a place like that left?
Honestly, I thought we'd already been everywhere
in the school...

There's still a spot you can enjoy precisely
because Island 1 has no seasons.

No way, I can't even imagine it...
Where on earth is it?
Then just be good and follow me.
rows.notes: otonashiku tsuite kite: 'be good and follow me' (teasing, keeps the surprise).

rows.en:
Wait, it's just the pool! I got my hopes up
for nothing!

But for unwinding, there's no better place
left in the school.
Doesn't being near water kind of calm you down?

Well, that's true. There may be no other place
in the school this open and relaxing.
And so, my school tour is now officially over!
Sheryl?
It's hot today. Shall we go for a little swim?

Come on, the changing rooms have swimsuits
for class, right?

They do, but...
if the teachers catch us...
Now that that's decided, let's get going!
(Hey, nobody decided anything...)
Let's swiiim!
Sigh... Why do I have to swim too...

Come on, what's with that face?
When it's time to have fun, have fun properly.
Well, now that it's come to this...!
That's it, that's the spirit!
(Phew, I ended up having a blast anyway...)
See? Aren't you glad we went for it?
Plus, you got to see me in a swimsuit!
Huh... Ah... Well...

Hee hee, I'm joking.
Come on, let's get changed. You'll catch a cold.
Okay, okay.

(We did something surprisingly bold, right
here at school...)

(I've pretty much shown her everything around
the school... I guess that place is all that's left...)

Hi~, \p-chan.
So... what about today?
Are you going to show me a good time?

Well, today we're going to the best place in
school to unwind...

There's still a spot you can enjoy precisely
because Island 1 has no seasons.
Then please just be good and follow me.

But for unwinding, there's no better place
left in the school.
Don't you find being near water kind of calming?
And so, my school tour is now over.
Sheryl-san?

They do, but...
if the teachers catch us...
(Oh, geez, Sheryl-saaan...)
Sigh... I can't believe I'm swimming too...
You're right. Now that it's come to this...!
(Phew, I ended up having a blast anyway...)
Okay, time to get changed. You'll catch a cold.

(We did something surprisingly bold, right
here at school...)
(Now, where should I take Sheryl today...)

\p!
Come on, let's go!
Huh!? Go where?
To the pool, obviously!
